quotes.speaker: Luguentz Dort
quotes.summary_phrase: Luguentz Dort on his transition from soccer to basketball
quotes.excerpt: I used to play soccer growing up at first, and the group of friends that I had
quotes.quote: I used to play soccer growing up at first, and the group of friends that I had all played basketball. So it came to a point where I was hanging out a lot with them and we used to go play and I was playing both sports at the same time. At some point my mom was just like, you got to make a decision between soccer and basketball. And the fact that all my friends were playing basketball, I just decided to go with it.

quotes.speaker: Luguentz Dort
quotes.summary_phrase: Luguentz Dort on the emotional difficulty of going undrafted
quotes.excerpt: It was a tough night. Obviously, played a year in college, I thought I had enough to be drafted.
quotes.quote: It was a tough night. Obviously, played a year in college, I thought I had enough to be drafted. I'm sitting down, I can hear all the names go on, the first round goes through. I'm disappointed obviously, but I still feel like I got a chance early in the second round. The first couple picks is being called and I kind of went down. I felt bad, I got up and I left, I didn't stay until the end of the draft. It was just a tough night, disappointed, sad, there was a bunch of emotion at the same time.

quotes.speaker: Luguentz Dort
quotes.summary_phrase: Luguentz Dort on the challenge of guarding NBA superstars
quotes.excerpt: The assignment to guard some of the All-Star, the best players in the league, that's my first year.
quotes.quote: My first couple games was against Denver where I had to guard Jamal Murray, then I played the Jazz, I had to guard Donovan Mitchell, then I had to play Portland which I had to guard Damian Lillard. So the assignment to guard some of the All-Star, the best players in the league, that's my first year. So I was like, effort, just throw me out there and let's see, let's see how I do. And then that was just to trust some from my coaches at the time.

quotes.speaker: Luguentz Dort
quotes.summary_phrase: Luguentz Dort on his pride in being an All-Defensive selection
quotes.excerpt: I was real proud. It took a long time. I've been doing the same stuff for the past
quotes.quote: I was real proud. It took a long time. I've been doing the same stuff for the past few years which I didn't really get recognized for that, but last year was just the perfect time that I got recognized for that.

quotes.speaker: Luguentz Dort
quotes.summary_phrase: Luguentz Dort on his physical defensive style and player complaints
quotes.excerpt: People that are watching our game doesn't like when the best players are being stopped.
quotes.quote: People that are watching our game doesn't like when the best players are being stopped. Obviously, the way that I do it is really physical. Obviously, I never try to hit or injure anybody, that's not me, but it's a physical game and I'm involved in those possessions so much. I take a lot of pride on that side of the court. I hear people complaining about it, it's a physical game.

quotes.speaker: Luguentz Dort
quotes.summary_phrase: Luguentz Dort on his defensive approach against Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: Luka, good one. Physicality is the biggest one. You know, try my best to stay in front of him.
quotes.quote: Luka, good one. Physicality is the biggest one. You know, try my best to stay in front of him and make him take some tough shots.

quotes.speaker: Luguentz Dort
quotes.summary_phrase: Luguentz Dort on his defensive strategy against James Harden
quotes.excerpt: James Harden, just being able to keep my hands out. You know, he's really good at drawing fouls.
quotes.quote: James Harden, just being able to keep my hands out. You know, he's really good at drawing fouls, so try my best to stay in front of him and always show my hands so he can't draw any fouls.

quotes.speaker: Luguentz Dort
quotes.summary_phrase: Luguentz Dort on his defensive strategy against Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: Pressuring him, you know, obviously he plays a lot of pick and roll with Jokic.
quotes.quote: Pressuring him, you know, obviously he plays a lot of pick and roll with Jokic, so try my best to stay in front of him, not get screened.

quotes.speaker: Luguentz Dort
quotes.summary_phrase: Luguentz Dort on his defensive strategy against Anthony Edwards
quotes.excerpt: Stay in front of him, not go for all the skill dribble move that he's doing.
quotes.quote: Stay in front of him, not go for all the skill dribble move that he's doing.

quotes.speaker: Luguentz Dort
quotes.summary_phrase: Luguentz Dort on his defensive strategy against Devin Booker
quotes.excerpt: Devin Booker is a tough one. He's for me, it's more like like Luka, just physicality.
quotes.quote: Devin Booker is a tough one. He's for me, it's more like like Luka, just physicality, trying to stay in front of him and contest every shot. I mean, he's going to make a lot of tough shots, he's one of them.

quotes.speaker: Luguentz Dort
quotes.summary_phrase: Luguentz Dort on choosing an Olympic gold over an NBA title
quotes.excerpt: Winning a gold medal because obviously Canada has gave my family a great opportunity to have a better life.
quotes.quote: Winning a gold medal because obviously Canada has gave my family a great opportunity to have a better life.

quotes.summary_phrase: Luguentz Dort on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's legacy
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to say Shai. I think Shai is going to achieve more than when he's done.
quotes.quote: I'm going to say Shai. I think Shai is going to achieve more than when he's done, he was going to achieve more than Steve Nash did.
